text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: *chomp, nibble nibble*...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: Tsurumaru-san can eat quite a bit more now, too, can't she~?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Still, to think the thing you wanted to eat
after graduating from jelly was a meat bun...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! I know all about it!
Meat buns are the best "post-workout snack"!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Trainer was the one who taught me!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's health has bounced back.
With how she is now, she can compete in the Japan Derby.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I look down at the Derby entry
registration documents in my hands.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even the time I clocked today beat my personal best from back during the Satsuki Sho.
I've also polished my strategy for the Derby to perfection.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —This is a decision made with everything taken into account.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Japan Derby.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"...Yup. I don't have
any pressing concerns at the moment~."
choice_data_list: Alright, Tsuyoshi! Let's give it everything we've got!
Alright, Tsuyoshi! Let's give it everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Yes! Ah, also! Um!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!
Trainer, Doctor!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: Now, now, it's too early for that~.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Save your thanks for after we're done.
...I'll be waiting for them after our victory.
choice_data_list: I believe in your victory, Tsuyoshi.
I'm counting on you to win, Tsuyoshi.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
~~gh, yes!!
I'm definitely going to seize this chance!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I know I've caused you so much,
so much worry, but...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Just like the President, my run in the Derby
will blow away all of everyone's worries!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SLAM!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (...Yes! Yes yes yes!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(I made it in time! I got to run in the Derby!
Just like the President, in the Derby...!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I will win!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting! Spe-chan!
Sei-chan! King-chan!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: To the stage that decides the best in Japan—I have arrived!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha, well now, someone's looking confident.
Now then, how's your condition?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
In top condition!
So, today is—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Big Ribbon
text_block_list.text: —Tsuru-chaaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Big Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
"I-It's gonna be totally fine~~~!
Don't be nervous, just re-re-relax~~~!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Big Ribbon
text_block_list.text: Go win it all todayyyyy!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Tsuru-chan's cheering squad is so wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Gets you pumped up, right?
...Hehe. *Inhaaaale*...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Just waaaatch meee!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I definitely! Definitely, definitely will!
I'm gonna become a Derby Umamusume!
